title: Registered
subtitle: 「已註冊／正式登記／持牌」，究竟是哪一種 registered？
description: 「已註冊／正式登記／持牌」，究竟是哪一種 registered？

words.note: 最直接的同義改寫，表示已按正式程序登記在官方系統、名冊或紀錄中。
words.example: Only officially registered organisations may apply for the grant.
words.exampleZh: 只有正式註冊的機構才可申請這項資助。

exercises.original: Only registered charities can apply for this funding.
exercises.zh: 只有正式註冊的慈善機構才可申請這項資助。
exercises.upgrade: officially registered · 正式註冊的

options.explanation: licensed = 慈善機構是否持牌和是否正式登記是不同法律概念。
certified = 慈善身份通常不是靠技能認證取得。
officially registered = 句子明確涉及法定 charity status，因此 officially registered 最直接。
approved = 獲批准某項申請不等於擁有 registered charity status。
listed = 只列在一般目錄未必具正式註冊效力。
member = 慈善機構不是因成為某組織會員而取得法定註冊身份。

exercises.original: The business is registered with the national tax authority.
exercises.zh: 這間企業已向國家稅務機關正式登記。
exercises.upgrade: officially registered · 正式註冊的

options.explanation: certified = 稅務登記不是能力認證。
licensed = 企業可能另需營業牌照，但 tax registration 本身不是 licence。
approved = 並非單純申請被批准。
officially registered = with the national tax authority 表示官方登記，因此答案自然。
listed = 不能充分表達已完成正式登記程序。
accredited = 不合稅務語境。

exercises.original: All registered providers receive a unique identification number.
exercises.zh: 所有正式註冊的服務提供者都會獲得唯一識別號碼。
exercises.upgrade: officially registered · 正式註冊的

options.explanation: licensed = license status 可能另有編號，但原句核心是登記系統。
certified = 資格認證未必給 provider registration number。
approved = 批准不等於進入 register。
listed = 一般列名不足以解釋 unique registration number。
officially registered = unique identification number 是正式 registration 的典型結果。
member = 會員編號和監管登記不同。

words.meaning: 正式列入名冊；正式登記
words.note: 當 registered 指某人、機構或項目已被正式列入某份名冊、資料庫或官方清單時可用；比一般 registered 更突出『列名』。
words.example: The charity is formally listed in the national register.
words.exampleZh: 這間慈善機構已正式列入國家名冊。

exercises.original: The organisation is registered in the national database.
exercises.zh: 該機構已正式列入國家資料庫。
exercises.upgrade: formally listed · 正式列入名冊；正式登記

options.explanation: licensed = 資料庫列名不等於獲營運許可。
certified = 不表示通過認證。
approved = 可能已批准，但句子只說已列入 database。
formally listed = in the national database 明確突出被列入正式清單。
member = 不合。
accredited = 不合一般 database listing。

exercises.original: Her name is registered in the official directory of practitioners.
exercises.zh: 她的名字已正式列入從業員官方名錄。
exercises.upgrade: formally listed · 正式列入名冊；正式登記

options.explanation: licensed = 有些 professions 需要 licence，但 directory listing 本身是列名。
certified = 不是在說考核合格。
member = directory 可以包含 members，但原句重點是 official listing。
approved = 不自然修飾 name in directory。
formally listed = name ... in the official directory 最自然用 formally listed。
enrolled = 較常用於課程／計劃。

exercises.original: The property is registered on the heritage list.
exercises.zh: 該物業已正式列入文物名錄。
exercises.upgrade: formally listed · 正式列入名冊；正式登記

options.explanation: licensed = 物業文物身份不是營業牌照。
certified = 不合 heritage status。
member = 物業不是會員。
approved = 獲批准維修和列入 heritage list 是不同概念。
enrolled = 不合。
formally listed = heritage register/list 的核心就是正式列名。

words.note: 當 registered 的重點是資料已被正式記錄下來時可用，例如 birth、ownership、transaction 等。
words.example: The ownership change was recorded in the official records.
words.exampleZh: 業權變更已在官方紀錄中登記。

exercises.original: The transfer of ownership was registered in the land records.
exercises.zh: 業權轉移已在土地紀錄中登記。
exercises.upgrade: recorded · 登記在案；記錄

options.explanation: licensed = 業權轉移不是獲牌照。
certified = 不合 transaction record。
enrolled = 不是加入課程或制度。
member = 不合。
recorded = in the land records 強調官方紀錄中已記下該交易，recorded 最精確。
accredited = 不合。

exercises.original: The birth was registered shortly after the child was born.
exercises.zh: 孩子出生後不久，其出生資料便被登記在案。
exercises.upgrade: recorded · 登記在案；記錄

options.explanation: licensed = 出生不涉及許可。
certified = birth certificate 可之後發出，但 birth event 本身是 recorded。
enrolled = 不合。
approved = 不合。
listed = 太泛，未表達事件紀錄。
recorded = birth registration 的核心是把事件正式記錄在 civil records。

exercises.original: The complaint was registered in the system at 9:15 a.m.
exercises.zh: 投訴在上午九時十五分被登記到系統。
exercises.upgrade: recorded · 登記在案；記錄

options.explanation: recorded = 系統中記錄一項 complaint 和 timestamp，recorded 最自然。
licensed = 不合。
approved = 投訴被記錄不代表已獲接納。
certified = 不合。
member = 不合。
accredited = 不合。

words.note: 當 registered 指某人正式加入課程、計劃、學校、保險或會員制度時適用；比一般 registered 更強調加入資格。
words.example: More than two hundred students are enrolled in the programme.
words.exampleZh: 超過二百名學生已註冊參加這個課程。

exercises.original: She is registered in the university's nursing programme.
exercises.zh: 她已註冊入讀大學護理課程。
exercises.upgrade: enrolled · 登記加入；註冊入讀

options.explanation: licensed = 學生尚未因此取得護理執業牌照。
certified = 入讀課程不等於已通過認證。
listed = 可被列在名單上，但不能完整表達正式入讀。
approved = 被錄取和已完成 enrolment 不同。
accredited = 通常形容 course/institution，不是 student。
enrolled = 正式加入 programme 的學生最自然說 enrolled in。

exercises.original: More than five hundred people are registered for the training course.
exercises.zh: 超過五百人已登記參加培訓課程。
exercises.upgrade: enrolled · 登記加入；註冊入讀

options.explanation: enrolled = 課程參加者的正式加入狀態用 enrolled 最自然。
licensed = 參加課程不等於持牌。
certified = 他們可能尚未完成課程。
recorded = 只是有紀錄，未充分表達參加身份。
accredited = 不能一般形容參加者。
approved = 不表示已正式加入課程。

exercises.original: He registered in the health insurance plan after starting his new job.
exercises.zh: 他開始新工作後加入了醫療保險計劃。
exercises.upgrade: enrolled · 登記加入；註冊入讀

options.explanation: licensed = 不合 insurance membership。
enrolled = 正式加入 insurance plan 可自然用 enrolled in。
certified = 不是資格認證。
listed = 只表達名單存在，不如 enrolled 表達加入 plan。
approved = 保險申請批准和加入 plan 不完全相同。
recorded = 過於一般。

words.note: 較一般，表示名字、機構、產品或資料已出現在某份正式或公開名單中；不一定代表獲得許可。
words.example: The company is listed in the official directory.
words.exampleZh: 該公司已列入官方名錄。

exercises.original: The company is registered in the local business directory.
exercises.zh: 公司已列入本地商業名錄。
exercises.upgrade: listed · 列入名單；登記

options.explanation: listed = 若只表示出現在 directory 中，listed 比 registered 更準確。
licensed = business directory 不等於營業牌照。
certified = 不合目錄列名。
accredited = 不合一般 business listing。
enrolled = 公司不是加入課程。
approved = 未說經任何審批。

exercises.original: All registered prices appear on the website.
exercises.zh: 所有列出的價格都會出現在網站上。
exercises.upgrade: listed · 列入名單；登記

options.explanation: licensed = 價格不會持牌。
listed = price 在網站或清單上出現時，應用 listed，不是法律 registration。
certified = 價格不會認證。
enrolled = 不合。
accredited = 不合。
approved = approved price 是另一概念，表示獲批准的價格。

exercises.original: The restaurant is registered in the guide as one of the city's recommended places.
exercises.zh: 這間餐廳在指南中被列為城市推薦地點之一。
exercises.upgrade: listed · 列入名單；登記

options.explanation: licensed = restaurant 可持牌，但 guide recommendation 和牌照不同。
certified = 不是食品安全認證語境。
listed = guide 中的條目應用 listed，不應把它誤解為法定註冊。
enrolled = 不合。
recorded = 可理解但 listed in a guide 是固定自然說法。
member = 不合。

words.note: 正式、具體的說法，表示某人或機構的名稱已被加入官方 register；特別適合法律、專業和監管語境。
words.example: The practitioner must be entered on the register before using the protected title.
words.exampleZh: 該從業員在使用受保護職稱前必須登記在名冊上。

exercises.original: The doctor must be registered before practising independently.
exercises.zh: 醫生在獨立執業前必須正式登記在名冊上。
exercises.upgrade: entered on the register · 登記在名冊上

options.explanation: listed in a directory = 一般名錄列名未必具有執業法律效力。
entered on the register = 專業人士必須進入法定 register 才可執業，這個說法最精確。
certified = 通過資格認證可能是前提，但本句要求的是 registration status。
licensed = 某些制度另有 licence，但這裡明確是 register。
enrolled = 不合專業註冊。
member = 加入專業學會不一定等同法定 register。

exercises.original: Only nurses registered with the regulator may use the protected title.
exercises.zh: 只有在監管機構名冊登記的護士才可使用受保護職稱。
exercises.upgrade: entered on the register · 登記在名冊上

options.explanation: members = 學會會員不一定具有法定 title protection。
listed online = 網站列名不一定等同正式法定 register。
entered on the register = protected title + regulator 是正式 register 語境。
approved = 未完整表達持續註冊身份。
enrolled = 不合專業資格。
certified = 認證與法定登記是不同程序。

exercises.original: The architect's name was registered after all requirements were met.
exercises.zh: 建築師在符合所有要求後，其姓名被登記在正式名冊上。
exercises.upgrade: entered on the register · 登記在名冊上

options.explanation: licensed = 可能另有 licence，但原句是 name being added to register。
listed in a brochure = 不具監管效力。
enrolled = 不合。
entered on the register = all requirements were met 後正式加入名冊，entered on the register 最準確。
member = 不是單純會員資格。
recorded casually = 不能表達正式 professional registration。

words.note: 表示資料已存在於官方或正式紀錄中；比 registered 更偏『已有紀錄』而不是登記程序本身。
words.example: The address on record must be updated within thirty days.
words.exampleZh: 登記在案的地址必須在三十日內更新。

exercises.original: The address registered for the account is no longer correct.
exercises.zh: 帳戶登記在案的地址已不再正確。
exercises.upgrade: on record · 有正式紀錄；登記在案

options.explanation: licensed = 地址沒有 licence status。
certified = 不合。
on record = 帳戶系統現有的正式地址資料可自然稱 address on record。
enrolled = 不合 address。
approved = 已批准地址不是常見概念。
accredited = 不合。

exercises.original: We need to update the telephone number registered in our records.
exercises.zh: 我們需要更新紀錄中登記在案的電話號碼。
exercises.upgrade: on record · 有正式紀錄；登記在案

options.explanation: listed publicly = 公開列出的號碼和內部 official record 不同。
licensed = 不合。
certified = 不合。
on record = 內部正式紀錄中的聯絡資料常用 on record。
enrolled = 不合。
approved = 不合。

exercises.original: The bank can only send notices to the registered address.
exercises.zh: 銀行只能把通知寄往登記在案的地址。
exercises.upgrade: on record · 有正式紀錄；登記在案

options.explanation: licensed address = 沒有這種一般概念。
certified address = 通常不作此義。
listed address = 可指公開名單，不一定是銀行正式記錄。
enrolled address = 不自然。
on record = 金融帳戶資料中，address on record 是非常自然的固定說法。
approved address = 未必是 official account record。

words.note: 只有當 registered 在某語境實際表示經認可機構正式承認資格或標準時才接近；accredited 並不等同單純登記。
words.example: The course is accredited by the national professional body.
words.exampleZh: 這個課程獲國家專業機構認證。

exercises.original: The registered training provider is recognised by the national professional body.
exercises.zh: 這間培訓機構獲國家專業機構正式認可。
exercises.upgrade: accredited · 獲認可的；經認證的

options.explanation: listed = 只列名不足以表示 recognised by professional body。
licensed = 營運牌照和專業認可不同。
enrolled = 機構不是參加課程。
accredited = recognised by the national professional body 明確是 accreditation，而不只是 registration。
recorded = 太弱。
member = 加入某組織不代表其課程受認可。

exercises.original: Students must attend a registered programme that meets professional standards.
exercises.zh: 學生必須修讀一個符合專業標準的認可課程。
exercises.upgrade: accredited · 獲認可的；經認證的

options.explanation: licensed = programme 通常說 accredited，不一定說 licensed。
listed = 列在網站上不表示 meets professional standards。
recorded = 不合。
enrolled = 這形容的是學生狀態，不是 programme status。
accredited = meets professional standards 表示課程經正式認可，accredited 最精確。
approved applicant = 不合。

exercises.original: The laboratory is registered under an international quality scheme.
exercises.zh: 這間實驗室已獲國際品質制度認可。
exercises.upgrade: accredited · 獲認可的；經認證的

options.explanation: listed = 不能表達 competence/quality recognition。
licensed = 可能需要 licence，但 quality scheme 通常是 accreditation。
enrolled = 不合。
recorded = 不合。
member = 加入 scheme 不一定等於獲 accreditation。
accredited = international quality scheme 下的正式能力認可通常用 accredited。

words.note: 當 registered 的語境同時要求政府或監管機構授權從事某活動時可近似；但 licensed 強調『許可』，registered 只強調『登記』。
words.example: Only licensed clinics may provide this treatment.
words.exampleZh: 只有持牌診所才可提供這項治療。

exercises.original: Only registered operators are legally permitted to provide the service.
exercises.zh: 只有獲正式許可的營運商才可合法提供服務。
exercises.upgrade: licensed · 持牌的；獲正式許可的

options.explanation: listed = 列在名單上不一定帶 legal permission。
certified = 資格認證未必等於法定營運許可。
enrolled = 不合。
recorded = 不具授權意味。
licensed = legally permitted to provide the service 是 licence 的直接定義，所以 licensed 最精確。
accredited = 品質認可和法律許可是不同概念。

exercises.original: The clinic must be registered before it can operate legally.
exercises.zh: 診所在合法營運前必須取得牌照。
exercises.upgrade: licensed · 持牌的；獲正式許可的

options.explanation: listed = 一般名錄列名不能授權營運。
certified = 可能證明某項標準，但不一定給 operation permission。
accredited = 品質認可不等同 legal licence。
enrolled = 不合。
recorded = 不合。
licensed = 如果前提是合法營運許可，應教 licensed 而不是把所有 registration 混為一談。

exercises.original: Only registered drivers may operate vehicles in this commercial category.
exercises.zh: 只有持牌司機才可駕駛這類商業車輛。
exercises.upgrade: licensed · 持牌的；獲正式許可的

options.explanation: licensed = 法律授權某人駕駛特定車輛，標準用語是 licensed。
listed = 司機出現在名冊上未必等於被授權駕駛。
certified = 訓練證書不一定代替駕駛牌照。
accredited = 通常不用來形容 driver legal permission。
recorded = 不合。
enrolled = 不合。

words.meaning: 經認證的；獲證明合資格的
words.note: 當 registered status 涉及正式資格證明時可接近，但 certified 強調已通過認證或獲發證明，不等於一般登記。
words.example: Certified technicians must renew their credentials every three years.
words.exampleZh: 經認證的技術員必須每三年更新資格。

exercises.original: The registered technician has passed the required competence assessment.
exercises.zh: 這名技術員已通過所需能力評核並獲認證。
exercises.upgrade: certified · 經認證的；獲證明合資格的

options.explanation: licensed = 某些職業另需 licence，但 passed competence assessment 更直接支持 certification。
listed = 列名不能證明已通過能力評核。
enrolled = 只是參加課程／計劃。
recorded = 不合。
accredited = 通常形容機構、課程或制度，而非個人技術員的這種資格。
certified = passed the required competence assessment 是 certification 的直接線索。

exercises.original: Only registered installers who have completed the approved training may use this label.
exercises.zh: 只有完成認可培訓並獲認證的安裝人員才可使用這個標誌。
exercises.upgrade: certified · 經認證的；獲證明合資格的

options.explanation: certified = 完成指定 training 後取得可識別資格，certified 最自然。
listed = 列在清單上未必證明完成培訓。
licensed = 法律牌照可能不同；本句焦點是 approved training。
enrolled = 只表示正在參加培訓。
recorded = 不合。
member = 會員身份不等於技能認證。

exercises.original: The equipment must be checked by a registered inspector with the required qualification.
exercises.zh: 設備必須由具所需資格的認證檢查員檢查。
exercises.upgrade: certified · 經認證的；獲證明合資格的

options.explanation: listed = 名冊列名不一定表示具指定 qualification。
certified = required qualification 指個人已獲資格認證，因此 certified 很精確。
licensed = 可能適用某些制度，但 qualification/certification 更直接。
enrolled = 不合。
recorded = 不合。
accredited = 個人通常更常說 certified。

words.note: 描述性但非常精確，表示已向指定政府部門、專業機構或監管單位完成登記。
words.example: All providers must be registered with the authority before operating.
words.exampleZh: 所有服務提供者在營運前都必須向主管機關登記。

exercises.original: All childcare providers must be registered before opening.
exercises.zh: 所有托兒服務提供者在開業前都必須向主管機關登記。
exercises.upgrade: registered with the authority · 已向主管機關登記

options.explanation: registered with the authority = 若核心是向指定監管機關完成登記，這個描述性改寫最精確。
listed in a directory = 一般目錄列名不具有監管效果。
certified = 未必要求技能考核。
enrolled = 不合服務提供者監管。
member = 加入行業協會不是同一程序。
recorded = 過於一般，沒有指出正式監管機關。

exercises.original: The business must be registered before it can submit the application.
exercises.zh: 企業必須先向主管機關登記，才可提交申請。
exercises.upgrade: registered with the authority · 已向主管機關登記

options.explanation: licensed = 此階段可能只需要登記，而非營業許可。
registered with the authority = 沒有證據說需要 licence，只能安全改寫為正式向 relevant authority 登記。
certified = 不是能力或品質認證。
listed = 一般名單不足以表達 regulator registration。
enrolled = 不合。
accredited = 不合。

exercises.original: Every provider is registered with the national regulator.
exercises.zh: 每個服務提供者都已向國家監管機構登記。
exercises.upgrade: registered with the authority · 已向主管機關登記

options.explanation: licensed by the regulator = 可能另需 licence，但原句只明確說 registration。
certified by the regulator = certification 和 registration 不同。
registered with the authority = with the national regulator 已經是精確自然的 registration 結構。
listed online = 過於弱。
enrolled = 不合。
accredited = 不合一般 provider register。

falseSynonyms.zh: 註冊不一定等於持牌 registered 只表示已被正式登記；licensed 表示獲准合法從事某活動。某些制度兩者都需要。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A business may be registered but still need a separate licence to operate.

falseSynonyms.zh: 登記不等於獲認證 certified 表示資格、能力或產品已獲正式證明；registered 不一定涉及考核或認證。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Registration records status; certification confirms that requirements have been met.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獲批准不等於已登記 approved 表示某項申請、產品或計劃獲接受；registered 表示被加入正式紀錄或名冊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An application can be approved before the resulting registration is completed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 列名不一定等於正式註冊 listed 可以只是出現在目錄或網站上；只有在官方 register 中列名時才接近 registered。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A company may be listed in a directory without being officially registered.

falseSynonyms.zh: 會員不等於註冊身分 member 表示屬於某組織；registered person 可以是會員，也可能只是被監管機構登記。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Membership and registration are separate statuses.

falseSynonyms.zh: 註冊與記錄焦點不同 recorded 只表示資料已留下紀錄；registered 通常包含正式登記程序。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A detail can be recorded without creating a formal registration status.

falseSynonyms.zh: 註冊與入讀／加入不同 enrolled 常用於課程、學校、計劃或保險；registered 的範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A student can be enrolled in a course and registered with a university system.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞與形容詞／分詞不同 register 是登記這個動作；registered 表示已完成登記或處於登記狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You register a business; once complete, the business is registered.
